title: Are AC service contracts worth it?
desc: Yes, AC service contracts are worth it as they offer regular maintenance, prevent costly breakdowns, and ensure your system runs efficiently. They also help extend the lifespan of your AC and reduce repair expenses.

title: How often should an AC be cleaned?
desc: An AC should be cleaned at least once a year, preferably before the cooling season. If used frequently or in dusty areas, cleaning every six months is recommended for optimal performance.

title: Is AC duct cleaning important in Dubai?
desc: Yes, AC duct cleaning is important in Dubai due to the high dust levels and heat. Regular cleaning helps improve air quality, efficiency, and prevents system issues caused by accumulated debris.

title: Why is my AC running but not cooling?
desc: If your AC is running but not cooling, it could be due to low refrigerant levels, a clogged air filter, or a faulty compressor. Other possible causes include issues with the thermostat or a dirty condenser coil.

title: Why is duct cleaning so expensive?
desc: Duct cleaning is expensive due to the specialized equipment, labor-intensive process, and the need for trained professionals. Accessing hard-to-reach areas also adds to the cost.
